isExplicit.description: Whether a value is stored rather than the default applying

storedValueValid.description: False when the stored value is no longer allowed and the default applies

group.description: Group label the settings page shows the setting under

default.description: Default value; null when the setting follows fallbackKey

options.description: Allowed values of an enum setting, with their labels

userVisible.description: Whether signed-in users can read this system setting

enforced.description: False while the backend does not yet honour the setting

fallbackKey.description: System setting a user setting follows when unset

errorClass.description: Exception class of the last failure

errorMessage.description: Exception message of the last failure

retryCount.description: Retries from the failure transport that failed again

isDefault.description: Whether this is the default profile

choice.description: The user's explicit choice; null when they have none

resetValue.description: The value the setting would have after a reset

editable.description: Whether the user may change the setting themselves

bearerAuth.description: DPoP-bound access token (JWT), sent as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` with a DPoP proof. First-party apps obtain it via `/api/auth/login`, `/api/auth/login/passkey` or `/api/auth/refresh`; other clients via `/api/oauth/token`.

oauth2AuthCode.description: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with mandatory S256 PKCE. Token requests need a nonce-bearing DPoP proof, and the issued tokens are DPoP-bound.
